cases.input: An agreement receives two executed amendments.
cases.expect: Original and two amendment instruments plus three expressions remain resolvable; clause work IDs persist and affected duties rebind without rewriting predecessors.

cases.input: An obligor performs part of a quantified duty.
cases.expect: Accepted quantity accumulates, outstanding quantity remains derivable as-of, and unconditional discharge is not inferred.

cases.input: A contractual SLA measurement is challenged.
cases.expect: Research expectation places the challenged measurement on the duty, but executable acceptance is blocked until the SLA field floor is ratified.

cases.input: A third party performs a delegated duty.
cases.expect: Research expectation recorded, but acceptance is blocked until the corresponding party-change or acceptance/evidence mastership semantics are ratified.
Research expectation requires release-and-substitute and successor links; executable acceptance is blocked until typology is ratified.

cases.input: Fulfilment evidence is revoked after acceptance.
cases.expect: Research expectation recorded, but acceptance is blocked until the corresponding party-change or acceptance/evidence mastership semantics are ratified.

cases.input: A service-level miss triggers a credit.
cases.expect: A secondary duty records the credit and a governing-regime profile supplies its legal class; no model-level enforceability conclusion is made.

cases.input: An internal dashboard SLO is presented as a contractual guarantee without incorporation.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected because no executed clause, obligee, enforceable criterion or consequence exists.

cases.input: An amendment overwrites the prior signed expression.
cases.expect: Validation rejects mutation and requires a new instrument, successor expression and preserved predecessor.

cases.input: Delegation automatically discharges the original obligor and changes execution occupancy.
cases.expect: The invalid inference is identified, but executable rejection is blocked until party-change typing is ratified.

cases.input: The contract expression stores live outstanding quantity and per-duty dispute state.
cases.expect: Validation rejects dual mastership; those facts belong to WM-XCT-029.

cases.input: Revoked evidence deletes the earlier acceptance event.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected and reopening must append.

cases.input: Every service credit is classified as an unenforceable penalty.
cases.expect: The jurisdiction-free conclusion is rejected and requires a governing-regime profile.

cases.input: An executed amendment incorporates an internal target with full SLA fields.
cases.expect: A contractual duty is derived only from the new executed expression; the earlier dashboard target remains non-contractual.

cases.input: A conformed text projection overwrites a signed expression.
cases.expect: Validation rejects mutation; the projection remains derived and separately identified.

cases.input: Observation time is substituted for legal-effect time on a duty transition.
cases.expect: Validation rejects temporal collapse and preserves both times.

cases.input: Two exclusive-remedy elections are simultaneously effective for one claim.
cases.expect: Validation rejects concurrent elections and requires an append-only supersession chain.

cases.input: Acceptance with reservation is treated as unconditional discharge.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the inference and preserves outstanding quantity, reservation and dispute state.
